meta.name: Gobhir Joler Maach
meta.description:
These four women appear to be the picture of true friendship but underneath lie secrets and scandals - infidelity, deception, blackmail, and even murder.

Returning Series · First aired 10 Feb 2023 · India · Language: English
Studio: Hoichoi

Not complete. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 1/8 (missing E2-8)

On your server — Audio: Bengali, English (from file names)

videos.title: A Deadly Game
videos.overview: The usual chit-chat of four lifelong friends turns into a nightmare when Chandrima, reeling from the discovery of her husband's extramarital affair, drags the others into a deadly game.

videos.title: Damsels in Distress
videos.overview: While the three friends make calculated first moves in the secret game, Chandrima's move almost derails their efforts.

videos.title: First Date
videos.overview: On the first date, the three women throw dirt at each other's picture-perfect marriages. But what happens when the husbands start unmasking their wives?

videos.title: It was Love
videos.overview: Chandrima's sudden death forces the three friends to wrap the truth in lies without realizing there's one person who knows it all. The hide-and-seek trail takes a drastic turn with a shocking revelation.

videos.title: Who is to Blame?
videos.overview: The blame game becomes the worst nightmare for Bishakha. Meanwhile, the police bring in Suresh for interrogation, which baffles the others.

videos.title: Another Game?
videos.overview: When Suresh is about to spill the beans, the three friends become desperate to secure their alibies. But, soon they realise that their husbands are playing a game of their own.

videos.title: End is Near
videos.overview: Leaving her friends in the dark, Chandrima lured their husbands into another deadly game. Will the rocky trails of the two games ever intersect?

videos.title: Scandal and Climax
videos.overview: The cross-questioning of police with the three couples leads to more confusion around Chandrima's whereabouts. To everyone's shock, the climax ends with another fall.

videos.title: Something Fishy
videos.overview: While the girl gang was on a trip, the husbands had plotted a not-so-benign game.
